title: ControlSurface.pad_layout
setup_and_action: Independently establish supported Push2/3 mode and instrument contexts, then query/observe pad_layout while changing only an actually supported mode through its existing owner. Retain full returned symbols and availability; no invented layout-switch API.
source_claim: The symbol is get/observe only. Printed Push2/3 layouts distinguish melodic64, melodic64+variations, sequencer, sequencer+32notes; drum variations,64pads,loop selector,16velocities,16pitches; and session. Instrument and Note/Session/Layout context conditions apply. This is not a settable layout selector or a Push1 protocol.

title: ControlSurface.get_control
setup_and_action: On an independently admitted active surface choose a known name from its admitted name listing, request that control, and retain returned identity. Missing surface or name-list access is not an unsupported-name result.
source_claim: Parameter name is printed without a declared type; the function returns the named control. Control object class, missing-name return and usable name grammar are not supplied.

title: ControlSurface.get_control_names
setup_and_action: For one admitted active surface request its control-name list and independently validate one known available control; repeat after a separately supported surface reconfiguration only as ungraded lifecycle evidence.
source_claim: Returns a list of all control names for that surface. Ordering, name encoding, list length and implicit function arguments are unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.grab_control
setup_and_action: Use an independently identified control and establish its ordinary positive functionality; propose grab, retain ownership/functionality observations, then independently restore/release on a reset copy. Never use absent functionality as sole proof of a successful grab.
source_claim: Parameter control is printed without a type. Taking ownership releases standard functionality of that control for exclusive Max for Live use; the statement is scoped to that owned control, not a global hardware mute.

title: ControlSurface.grab_midi
setup_and_action: With independently admitted script-requested and bypassing track message contexts, establish positive reception at their respective owners, then compare surface API forwarding after grab. Do not treat unavailable script or missing input as a passing exclusion.
source_claim: Forwarding concerns messages the surface script receives and explicitly requests from Live. Pure realtime track messages can bypass that script; Push Note pads are the source example, contrasted with Session. This does not promise all raw MIDI from the hardware.

title: ControlSurface.register_midi_control
setup_and_action: On an independently admitted MaxForLive surface propose separate valid note,CC,pitchbend registrations with independently accepted numbers/names, then obtain and grab each returned control. Record IDs and associated forwarding; no numeric ID, wire codec or send_value signature oracle.
source_claim: MaxForLive surface only: name[symbol],status[int],number[int]. Printed status codes are144 note-on,176 CC,224 pitchbend. Returns the control LOM ID; associated forwarding is described after registration plus grab. A send_value call on the returned control is mentioned without defining that separate object member.

title: ControlSurface.release_control
setup_and_action: Establish a positively functioning ordinary control and separately confirmed grab, propose release, and retain ordinary functionality/ownership observations. Repeated or wrong-owner release remains ungraded.
source_claim: Parameter control is printed without a type. Release re-establishes the standard functionality for that control; return value and repeated/unowned-release semantics are unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.release_midi
setup_and_action: Establish positive script-requested forwarding after an independently admitted grab, propose release_midi, and retain both source activity and API output so silence cannot be attributed to missing input.
source_claim: Stops forwarding messages received from that surface to Max for Live. Interaction with other receivers or automatic cleanup is unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.send_midi
setup_and_action: Use a separately admitted surface and non-destructive valid message owned by an independently documented profile; retain input and actual surface/output response. No arbitrary integer sequence, protocol bytes or success oracle is supplied here.
source_claim: Parameter midi_message is a list of int, sent to the surface. Range, message framing, running status, supported message classes, acknowledgement and return type are unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.send_receive_sysex
setup_and_action: Establish an independently admitted non-destructive request/response profile; separately propose timely and timed-out responses with MIDI grab off/on, retaining positive send/receive controls. Do not invent a seconds unit, int/float coercion, timeout boundary or response/report order.
source_claim: Printed parameters sysex_message[list of int],timeout[symbol,int] coexist with prose specifying timeout followed by a float and a default0.2 with no unit in this entry. It awaits a response: ungrabbed timed-out response is not forwarded; grabbed MIDI is always forwarded while timeout is still reported. Exact report grammar, units, response correlation and boundary timing remain U.
